headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: No Dogs in Space podcast has not released a new episode since July 2024. Season three, focusing on experimental rock, was an abbreviated run. The article expresses a desire for more content despite loving previous seasons.

headline: Zuckerberg’s yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: An Alaskan cruise ship rescued a skiff that ran out of fuel near Farragut Bay. Tracking data revealed Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was actually closer. The cruise ship received praise for its rescue efforts.

headline: 49ers coach says his Tesla was on Autopilot when he crashed
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in a car accident four weeks ago near Palo Alto. He initially took blame, but later disclosed his Tesla's Autopilot was engaged. The incident brings attention to semi-autonomous driving features.

headline: Dropbox is a PC builder’s best friend
summary: The author highlights Dropbox as an essential tool for PC builders, particularly for data backup. A personal experience details fears of losing a large crowdfunded game design project. Dropbox offers crucial protection against local data loss for creators.

headline: One Night Only Director Cut 'So Much Nudity' from Film Because Audiences Now Dislike Seeing It
summary: Director Will Gluck cut significant nudity from his film 'One Night Only.' He believes modern audiences are increasingly uncomfortable with on-screen nudity. This decision reflects a shift in contemporary viewing preferences.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Ending Explained and Book Differences
summary: The article explains the House of the Dragon Season 3 finale, including key betrayals and character deaths. It covers significant dragon devastation within the episode. Major book-to-show changes from 'Fire & Blood' are also highlighted.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Finale Recap and Review
summary: The House of the Dragon Season 3 finale receives a recap and review. A spectacular battle leaves everything to play for in the upcoming final season. The review notes a lack of conclusive ending despite the action.

headline: Warner Bros. Stirs Controversy After Posting 'Embarrassing' AI Dog Podcast for The End of Oak Street
summary: Warner Bros. is facing backlash for using an 'embarrassing' AI dog podcast to promote a new film. The promotion is for 'The End of Oak Street,' starring Ewan McGregor and Anne Hathaway. The use of AI in marketing has sparked significant controversy.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: Travelodge staff gave a domestic abuser a key to his victim's hotel room. The attacker subsequently kicked the door off its hinges, according to the victim. The incident raises serious questions about hotel security and guest safety protocols.

headline: Drought expected to be declared in more parts of England
summary: Officials are meeting to assess escalating water shortages across England. A new heatwave is building, intensifying concerns. More regions are expected to declare a drought on Monday.

headline: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: The prime minister plans to accelerate a ban on 'subscription traps' to alleviate cost-of-living pressures. Burnham is on a UK tour, making a series of announcements. The policy aims to help consumers avoid unwanted recurring charges.

headline: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appears in court after extradition
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appeared in court following his extradition from Dubai. The Irish Prison Service used a bulletproof and bombproof van for his transport. The 49-year-old's court appearance marks a major development in his case.
